title: v0.8.8 - Premium Visual Identity & Enterprise Cloud
description: A comprehensive visual identity overhaul introducing tier-based dynamic theming, enterprise-grade cloud integrations with BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) support, and improved documentation for cloud providers.

items.title: Bring Your Own Model (BYOM)
items.description: Enterprise users can now use their own cloud AI providers instead of Pegasus defaults.
details: AWS Bedrock Integration: Connect your AWS account and use Claude 3 Sonnet/Haiku directly.
Azure OpenAI Support: Use your private GPT-4 deployments for secure enterprise AI.
GCP Vertex AI: Access Gemini 1.5 Pro through your Google Cloud credentials.
Dynamic Model Switching: AIClient now resolves providers dynamically based on user preferences.
Enterprise Gating: BYOM features are available exclusively for Teams and Enterprise tiers.

items.title: AI Configuration API
items.description: New backend routes for managing AI provider preferences.
details: GET /ai-config: Retrieve current AI provider configuration.
POST /ai-config: Set preferred AI provider with entitlement validation.
GET /ai-config/models: List available models including connected cloud providers.
Vault Integration: AI preferences stored securely in the secret vault.

items.title: Cloud Provider Documentation
items.description: Comprehensive user-friendly setup guides for all cloud providers.
details: AWS Credentials Guide: Step-by-step IAM user creation and Access Key setup.
Azure OAuth Guide: Simple connect flow with troubleshooting tips.
GCP OAuth Guide: Google Cloud connection with consent screen guidance.
No developer knowledge required: Guides written for end-users, not admins.

items.title: Tier-Based Visual Identity
items.description: Dynamic, subscription-aware styling throughout the application.
details: Tier Gradients: Each subscription tier (Free, Pro, Pro+, Teams) now has its own signature color palette.
Profile Glow Border: User avatars feature an animated glow effect color-matched to their subscription tier.
Navigation Accents: Active tab underlines dynamically reflect the user's tier colors.
Loading Screen Gradients: The global loading progress bar now displays tier-specific gradient animations.
Progress Bar Theming: The GlobalProgressBar component uses tier-aware colors for all operations.

items.title: Consolidated Purchase Dashboard
items.description: Unified resource purchasing experience with tabbed navigation.
details: Single Card Interface: Combined 'Add Tokens' and 'Expand Storage' into one streamlined card.
Smart Tabbed Navigation: Tabs intelligently default to Tokens for paid tiers, Storage for free users.
Animated Price Ticker: Real-time price calculations with smooth NumberTicker animations.
NumberField Controls: Modern increment/decrement inputs replacing legacy sliders.

items.title: Enhanced Profile Header
items.description: Redesigned profile page header with consolidated subscription information.
details: Subscription Integration: Renewal dates and billing moved directly into the header.
Dynamic Tier Badges: Premium badges with gradient backgrounds matching subscription tier.
Organization Display: Company/team name now prominently shown with icon.
Streamlined Actions: Upgrade, Manage Plan, and Sign Out unified in header.

items.title: GlowBorder Component
items.description: New reusable animated border effect component.
details: CSS Mask Animation: Efficient radial gradient animation using CSS masks.
Configurable Colors: Accepts single color or array of colors for gradient.
Performance Optimized: Uses will-change and GPU-accelerated transforms.
Accessibility: Respects motion-safe preferences for reduced motion.

items.title: NumberTicker Component
items.description: Animated number display for dynamic value changes.
details: Smooth Transitions: Animated counting effect when values change.
Decimal Support: Configurable decimal places for currency displays.
Intersection Observer: Only animates when visible in viewport.
Theme Aware: Inherits text colors from parent containers.

items.title: Enhanced Cloud Resource Manager
items.description: Unified resource management with multi-provider support.
details: New Resource Button: Generic 'New Resource' button replaces specific KQL button.
Inline Provisioning: Opens CloudProvisionWizard at resource selection step with pre-filled context.
Multi-Provider API Calls: All API endpoints now use dynamic provider ID for Azure, AWS, GCP.
Dynamic Portal Links: 'Open in Portal' button routes to correct provider's console.
Provider Icons: AWS and GCP logos displayed alongside Azure in Resource Manager header.
shadcn Select Component: Resource Group dropdown now uses premium Select UI.

items.title: Cloud Provisioning Wizard Enhancements
items.description: Extended wizard with new resources, configuration modes, and progress tracking.
details: Azure Data Explorer (KQL): New resource option for big data analytics.
Azure OpenAI Restored: AI services option re-added to resource selection.
Configuration Mode Step: New Step 5 for choosing Pegasus Managed vs Custom Setup.
Manual Setup Link: Direct link to cloud provider's portal for custom configuration.
Default Config Info Dialog: Info button reveals default configurations per provider.
initialStep Prop: Wizard can start at any step with pre-filled subscription/location/RG.
Real-time Progress Polling: Provisioning status updates via 10-second polling interval.
Global Progress Integration: Uses useProgress for operation tracking in GlobalProgressBar.

items.title: Multi-Cloud Provider Backend
items.description: Full AWS and GCP integration in cloud-provision routes.
details: AWS Routes: GET /aws/subscriptions, /aws/locations, /aws/resources, POST /aws/provision.
GCP Routes: GET /gcp/subscriptions, /gcp/locations, /gcp/resources, POST /gcp/provision.
AWS S3 Integration: Lists real S3 buckets using @aws-sdk/client-s3.
GCP Storage Integration: Lists Cloud Storage buckets via @google-cloud/storage.
Dynamic Config Routes: GET/POST /:provider/config for storing user preferences per provider.
Resource Status Field: Added provisioningState to Azure resource listings.

items.title: Multi-Provider Cloud Auth
items.description: Complete authentication flows for AWS and GCP.
details: AWS Init: Direct credential storage from environment variables (no OAuth dance).
GCP OAuth Flow: Full Google OAuth2 with consent screen and token exchange.
Status Endpoints: GET /:provider/status checks connection for all three providers.
Disconnect Endpoints: DELETE /:provider/disconnect removes credentials from vault.
Parallel Status Check: CloudTab now checks Azure, AWS, and GCP status simultaneously.

items.title: AI Settings UI Enhancements
items.description: Model Provider selector added to AI settings tab.
details: Provider Cards: Visual selector for Pegasus, AWS, Azure, and GCP providers.
Lock States: Non-enterprise users see locked indicators with upgrade prompts.
Enterprise Badge: Clear indication that BYOM is an enterprise feature.
Auto-refresh: Page reloads to fetch models when provider changes.

items.title: Entitlement Service Expansion
items.description: Enhanced feature gating capabilities.
details: hasFeature() Method: Check if user has access to specific features by name.
BYOM Feature Flag: 'byom_models' feature available for teams/enterprise tiers.
manuallyGrantTier(): Admin function to provision enterprise accounts without Stripe.

items.title: Settings Tab Visibility
items.description: Cloud Infrastructure tab now tier-gated.
details: Dynamic Tab List: Cloud tab only visible for Teams/Enterprise subscribers.
Auto-redirect: If user downgrades, they're redirected to General tab.
Computed Tabs: Tab list is now reactive based on subscription tier.

items.title: shadcn-vue Card Standardization
items.description: Unified card components across the Profile page.
details: Dynamic Class Support: Card components now accept Vue object/array class syntax.
Consistent Styling: All profile sections use standardized Card/CardHeader/CardContent.
Type Safety: HTMLAttributes['class'] typing for proper TypeScript support.

items.title: Navbar Tier Display
items.description: Subscription tier visibility in navigation.
details: Desktop Navbar: Tier badge shown next to username with gradient styling.
Mobile Drawer: Consistent tier display in mobile navigation footer.
Profile Picture Cleanup: Removed legacy purple ring styling from avatars.
Global State: Migrated to useEntitlements composable for unified tier access.

items.title: Marketing Site Performance
items.description: Optimized hero section animations.
details: anime.js Integration: Replaced CSS keyframes with anime.js for constellation.
Sequential Shimmer: Preserved original 5s cycle with 0.5s staggered delays.
GPU Acceleration: SVG animations optimized for smooth 60fps rendering.
Bundle Size: anime.js v3.2.2 adds minimal overhead (~17kb gzipped).

items.title: Build System Fixes
items.description: Resolved production deployment issues.
details: NumberField Fix: Resolved esbuild transform error with v-model type casting.
Script Tag Restoration: Fixed malformed Vue SFC structure in number-field.vue.
Computed Refactor: Replaced useVModel with explicit computed get/set pattern.

items.title: Cloud AI Provider Architecture
items.description: New provider classes for cloud AI services.
details: AWSBedrockProvider: Interfaces with Bedrock Runtime API for Claude models.
AzureOpenAIProvider: Uses openai SDK with AzureOpenAI client configuration.
GCPVertexProvider: Integrates @google-cloud/vertexai for Gemini access.
Dynamic Instantiation: Providers created on-demand with user credentials from vault.

items.title: AIClient Refactoring
items.description: Enhanced model resolution with user context.
details: userId Parameter: getProviderForModel now accepts userId for BYOM resolution.
Prefix-based Routing: 'aws:', 'azure:', 'gcp:' prefixes route to cloud providers.
Fallback Chain: If cloud provider fails, gracefully falls back to default.
listModels Enhancement: Lists both default and user's connected cloud models.

items.title: Component Architecture
items.description: Improved component patterns and reusability.
details: tierDisplay Computed: Centralized tier-to-style mapping across components.
activeTabClass Computed: Unified navigation underline styling logic.
tierGradientClass: Shared gradient definitions for progress indicators.

items.title: Code Quality
items.description: Cleanup and standardization efforts.
details: Removed Redundant Code: Eliminated checkSubscription watchers in favor of global store.
Import Cleanup: Removed unused useVModel imports, added computed from vue.
Lint Compliance: Resolved empty ruleset warnings in constellation component.
Grid.vue Fixes: Moved constants to top of file, fixed unref usage for connections.

items.title: SecretService Path Resolution
items.description: Fixed environment variable loading in backend services.
details: Explicit .env Path: Uses fileURLToPath and path.resolve to locate .env from service directory.
Debug Logging: Logs the resolved .env path on service initialization.
Monorepo Compatibility: Fixes issues where dotenv couldn't find .env in complex project structures.

items.title: New UI Component Library Additions
items.description: shadcn-vue compatible components added to the design system.
details: Progress Component: Reka-UI based progress bar with indicator animation.
NumberField Component: Increment/decrement input with Plus/Minus buttons.
NumberTicker Component: Animated number transitions with viewport detection.
GlowBorder Component: Animated radial gradient border effect for cards.
CSS Glow Animation: Added @keyframes glow to styles.css with @theme inline block.

items.title: Resource Manager Auto-Close
items.description: UX improvement for cloud disconnection flow.
details: Auto-Close on Disconnect: Resource Manager closes when its provider is disconnected.
Provider-Aware Check: Only closes if the disconnected provider matches the open manager.
